interpretation: alpha-at-d-min-pose distributions are nearly IDENTICAL between failing and reachable head cases (median ~45-46deg either way), so this marginal is NOT what separates reachable from unreachable -- reachability is a joint/coupled property of the (alpha,d) trade-off surface near the optimum, not attributable to a single marginal quantity. Of FAILING cases, ~25% have alpha-at-d-min-pose exceeding the 60deg actuator limit (cone-bound), while ~68% sit within the actuator range (15-60deg) but outside the 15deg alpha_tol (tolerance-bound, not cone-bound) -- so most individual failing cases COULD in principle be resolved by loosening alpha_tol without widening the actuator cone, but a nontrivial minority genuinely need the cone widened.
